snippet.title: River City Super Sports Challenge - All Stars Special | PS3
snippet.description:
This is the gameplay trailer of River City Super Sports Challenge ~All Stars Special~. Reiho High School's student council president Todo arranges an athletes meet to make up for the trouble caused by the ex-student council president , Yamada. A very healthy and youthful approach. But in reality, it is intended to show off the power of Reiho High School. Meanwhile, Kunio and his friends are preparing for the meet at Nekketsu High School.

http://h2games.co.kr/rivercitysports/en/
